# T-6: Aggregate provider metrics

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Expose provider/profile buckets in status and metrics token JSON while preserving exact numeric totals.

## Acceptance Criteria
- get-status metricsSummary includes providers[provider][profileKey] with tokens-shaped buckets including costIncomplete.
- metrics token --format json rows and phaseSummary include providers[provider][profileKey] with row-shaped buckets including costIncomplete.
- Older entries without metadata aggregate under providers.unknown.unknown.
- Numeric totals equal exact source-entry sums.
- CACHE_VERSION is incremented and stale cached metrics rows are rebuilt.
- report output preserves existing tokenMetrics totals and ignores providers buckets.

## Implementation Notes
Keep existing text output stable unless a minimal provider summary is already expected by tests. JSON output is the required surface. report.js is a compatibility consumer only.

## Test Strategy
Pure aggregation tests for new and older metric entries; include cost sum and costIncomplete fixtures with multiple providers, metrics cache rebuild fixture, and report totals fixture.
